text: For the three months ending March 31, 2021, CreateTO gross expenditures are $0.37 million favourable compared to budget. Annual expenditures are expected to be in line with the approved budget of $14.6 million gross, $0 net.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Requested the Chief Financial Officer, CreateTO to report to the next meeting of the Board of Directors of CreateTO with information on revenues for CreateTO, including revenues related to Housing Now.
